declaredStatus.note: The BATTLE screen's layout and the runtime fields it may show. Layout numbers are PRODUCT-AUTHORED for a 9:16 phone frame. Every HUD field below is traced to a ROM read site, so the screen shows what the original tracks and nothing else. This file lives with the contracts rather than in src/ because src/championship carries no binary asset paths at all.

Battle profiles for the product's own three creatures. The SHAPE here is the original's: a stat-curve index plus the ten level fields ARM9 0x02062900 reads, fed through the same buildCreatureFromProfile the opponent path uses, so every stat is a curve row read back and nothing is computed. The VALUES are product-authored, and they have to be: Greyshade Cat, Blazetail Kit and Crystalfin Seahorse do not exist in the cartridge, so there is no ROM number to trace for them. Marking these PRODUCT_AUTHORED is not a gap in the reverse engineering; it is the honest label for creatures the product invented.
declaredStatus.shapeNote: statCurveIndex indexes ARM9 0x020CA008 column 0 for HP, exactly as a species record's +0x30 does. The ten level fields index the same curve's columns 1..6 exactly as an opponent preset's +0x14..+0x38 do. Both are checked against the ROM-derived catalogs at test time, so a value outside the 27-row curve fails rather than clamping.
declaredStatus.teamSizeNote: OVL10 0x02110A34 expands three opponents and OVL19 0x0210CCF0 advances the roster base by three per team, so three a side is the original's, not a product choice.
